verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage documents that risk alerts raised during ongoing monitoring can be prioritised and reviewed in case management, via the web app or the API. A case audit-trail endpoint also exists. This supports reviewing a new monitoring alert, but no evidence shows a view of what specifically changed in the customer's risk profile. Missing for 10: a documented change/delta view of profile or hit changes behind a monitoring alert, field-level before/after comparison, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
